artifact.title: Personal expense tracker: launch storage decision

nodes.title: Decision brief
nodes.text: Select a launch architecture for sensitive financial records. Seamless phone-and-laptop access is mandatory; offline continuity, recovery, privacy, and operational cost remain important.

nodes.title: At-a-glance comparison
nodes.text: Cloud sync meets the mandatory access requirement; local-only offers the smallest security and operating surface.

rows: Remote identity, storage, and access controls
Outage, lockout, conflict, breach, plus local failures

nodes.title: Weighted decision scorecard
nodes.text: Mandatory requirements have greater weight than convenience.

data.summary: Cloud sync leads because cross-device access is mandatory, while local safeguards preserve offline resilience.

nodes.title: Local-only: benefits
nodes.text: No account or connection is required. Sensitive records remain under direct device control, delivery scope is smaller, and behavior is predictable because distributed state is absent.

nodes.title: Local-only: risks
nodes.text: It cannot satisfy seamless launch access across phone and laptop. Device loss or corruption can also destroy records.

data.mitigation: Encrypted export/import, backup reminders, atomic writes, and tested recovery reduce loss but do not provide seamless access.

nodes.title: Cloud sync: benefits
nodes.text: Records follow the user across phone and laptop. Central backup improves device replacement, while an offline-first cache preserves everyday entry during connectivity loss.

nodes.title: Cloud sync: risks
nodes.text: Remote financial data and distributed state introduce account compromise, outages, conflicts, lockout, and continuing operational responsibility.

data.mitigation: Mature identity, least privilege, encryption, idempotent conflict-safe sync, auditable deletion, monitoring, and tested backup/account recovery.

nodes.title: Risk exposure map
nodes.text: Prioritize safeguards by likelihood and impact.

data.summary: Account compromise and silent sync conflict require the strongest preventive and recovery controls.

nodes.title: Safety chain
nodes.text: The recommendation depends on a complete safety chain.

nodes.title: Recommendation
nodes.text: Choose cloud sync for launch because it uniquely satisfies mandatory phone-and-laptop access. Ship it with an offline-first local cache, encrypted export, strong authentication, conflict-safe synchronization, and tested backup and recovery.

data.status: Recommended: cloud sync with offline-first safeguards
